response: The current K/DOQI treatment guidelines for treating vitamin D deficiency in Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) patients with ergocalciferol are inadequate. According to the available data, these guidelines are not sufficient to correct vitamin D deficiency or secondary hyperparathyroidism in CKD patients. It is suggested that future studies should investigate the effects of higher or more frequent dosing of ergocalciferol to better address these clinical endpoints and improve treatment outcomes for CKD patients with vitamin D deficiency.
